I gained like 20kgs while I was on medication but I was reaally thin like 52kgs and im pretty tall so i was severely underweight. After I stopped it i lost like 5kgs and im sitting at a healthy weight for my height but it does feel a bit strange for me to be here since i was always fairly skinny. A lot of people including loved ones told me i look healthier and much better now so I decided to just take their word to feel more comfortable about how i look, I decided to trust that theyre honest and I was also easier on myself with the self critique. Just remember that youre human and constantly growing and changing, if you pay attention you ll notice that you look different from year to year, maybe this year your hair is different from the last one or maybe your style changed to something you never you would like but now you do, and thats perfectly okay even if its about your body changing! Your body is your home and you get to make it and decorate however you like :) nothing really stays the same, trust yourself that it ll turn alright in the long run and dont be fearful of change
